challengeTypes: identify: What is a FORCE? (A push or a pull that acts on an object vs A type of sound vs A type of light)

extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Push and pull — force is a push or pull. Push: moves object AWAY from you (pushing a door, cart, swing, football). Pull: brings object CLOSER to you (pulling a drawer, rope, trolley, bucket from well). Both are force — the difference is direction. (2) Force changes shape and direction — force can: start motion, stop motion, change speed, change direction, change shape. Squeezing a ball changes its shape. Kicking a ball changes its direction. (3) Four types of force — muscular force (force of muscles — pushing, pulling, lifting). gravitational force (Earth pulls objects down — apple falling, ball dropping). magnetic force (magnet attracts iron — no contact needed). frictional force (opposes motion when surfaces rub — ball slows down). (4) Friction as a force — friction opposes motion when two surfaces rub. Always acts OPPOSITE to the direction of motion. Rough surfaces = more friction. Smooth surfaces = less friction. Ball rolls farther on marble floor than on grass. (5) Uses and harmful effects — useful: walking (without friction we slip), braking, writing, holding things, lighting matchstick. Harmful: wears out shoe soles, bicycle chain, tyres. Machine parts heat up. (6) Reducing friction — oil on bicycle chain (forms slippery layer, parts move smoothly). Grease on door hinges. Powder on carrom board (striker glides easily). These are called lubricants. Misconceptions: 'push and pull are different forces' (push and pull are the SAME force — the only difference is the DIRECTION: push is away, pull is toward), 'friction always slows things down so it is always bad' (friction is USEFUL — without it we could not walk, write, or hold things — it only needs to be reduced in machines), 'a rolling ball stops because it runs out of energy' (the ball stops because FRICTION between the ball and ground opposes its motion — it does not run out of energy), 'oil makes surfaces rougher' (oil makes surfaces SMOOTHER by filling in tiny bumps — it reduces friction, it does not increase it), 'gravity only pulls light things' (gravity pulls ALL objects toward Earth — heavy and light alike). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function ForceFrictionGame), NOT export default. Export interface ForceFrictionGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
